mechanism: Praziquantel is a CYP3A4 inducer that may decrease propafenone plasma concentrations, reducing antiarrhythmic efficacy, while propafenone may inhibit praziquantel metabolism via CYP3A4.
action: Monitor cardiac rhythm and propafenone efficacy; consider ECG monitoring and possible propafenone dose adjustment if praziquantel is added; verify therapeutic drug levels if available.
